Overview
For this role, we are seeking a qualified Software Engineer to join Epsilon’s Development Team in our Data Practice. In this role with our company, you will be focused on project tasks for Epsilon's TotalSource Plus (TSP) demographic and lifestyle products.
As a member of the Epsilon Data Team, you will work in a group that is not only focused on their project work but also their efficiency, compliance, standards, situational awareness, and readiness. You’ll be a critical part of a fast-moving, innovative team where you’ll work independently in some situations as well as working with a greater team in tasks that require full collaboration.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data processing solutions across on-premises and cloud environments using Python and Apache Spark on Databricks.
Optimize and fine-tune Spark jobs for performance, including resource utilization, shuffling, partitioning, and caching, to ensure maximum efficiency in large-scale big data environments.
Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant data pipelines with end-to-end monitoring, alerting, and logging.
Leverage AWS/DBX cloud services to build and manage data pipelines and distributed processing workloads.
Develop and optimize SQL queries across relational and data warehouse systems (RDBMS/Data Warehouse).

Use Git (or equivalent) for source control and maintain strong unit and integration testing practices.
Collaborate with Product Owners, partners, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

1-3 years of software development experience in a scalable, distributed, or multi-node environment.
Proficient in programming with Scala, Python, or Java; comfortable building data-driven solutions at scale, with Databricks preferred.

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to own problems end-to-end and deliver results.

Motivated to grow your career within a dynamic, innovative company.

BA/BS in Computer Science or related discipline.

description_preview:
AI Gateway Backend Engineer
Englewood, NJ (initial 2 months) & Plano, TX (from October onwards)
We are building an AI Gateway — a high-performance, secure intermediary layer that routes, inspects, and governs all traffic between enterprise clients and LLM/AI service providers. This role requires deep expertise in network programming, async Python, and cloud infrastructure to design and operate a latency-sensitive, policy-driven gateway that handles massive concurrent streaming connections at scale.
What we are looking for
Async Python & Network Programming (3 + yrs) – Strong hands‑on experience with asyncio, aiohttp/anyio, low‑level TCP/UDP sockets, WebSocket & SSE servers, TLS handshake, connection‑pooling, keep‑alive, and zero‑copy buffering.
Streaming & Large‑Payload Handling – Ability to manage chunked transfer, bidirectional streaming, back‑pressure and high‑throughput data paths for real‑time LLM inference.
Protocol Knowledge – Working familiarity with HTTP/2 & HTTP/3 (multiplexing, HPACK), gRPC, and occasional custom protocol parsers.
FastAPI‑Based Backend (3 + yrs) – Design, develop and test production‑grade REST/Streaming APIs; pragmatic use of Pydantic, dependency injection and OpenAPI docs.
Containerization & Kubernetes – Docker, AKS/EKS/GKE deployment experience; HPA/VPA scaling, rolling updates, and service‑mesh (e.g., Istio/Envoy) basics.
Async Messaging & Event‑Driven Design – Production use of Redis Streams, RabbitMQ or Kafka for decoupled task queues, retries and back‑off logic.
PostgreSQL & Vault – Advanced query tuning, partitioning, PgBouncer pooling, plus HashiCorp Vault (dynamic secrets, transit encryption) for key management.
Cloud Networking & Security – L4/L7 load balancing, TLS termination, reverse‑proxy (NGINX/Envoy), mTLS between services, and automated cert lifecycle (ACME/Let’s Encrypt).
IaC & CI/CD – Terraform modules for multi‑env infra, plus GitHub Actions/GitLab CI pipelines with container image scanning and canary/blue‑green deployments.
Work experience desired
Enterprise Security Gateways – Integration with CASB/DLP/WSS or similar edge‑security platforms; centralized logging & audit trails.
IAM & SSO – Configuring Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta, SAML 2.0 or OIDC SSO flows; managing Conditional Access & SCIM provisioning.
AI/LLM Pipelines – Building prompt‑engineering workflows, PII anonymisation, and monitoring Azure OpenAI (or comparable) usage, rate limits & cost.
API‑Gateway Operations – Custom webhook/REST integrations, circuit‑breaker patterns, rate‑limiting, auto‑retry and health‑checking.
Observability & FinOps – End‑to‑end monitoring with Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana or Azure Monitor; proactive cost‑optimisation and 24/7 incident response (SLA/SLO).

A fast-growing, seed-stage data infrastructure startup is hiring a
Full-Stack Software Engineer

550+ paying customers on 1–3 year contracts
, is
profitable and cash-flow positive
, and is growing quickly with a small, high-caliber engineering team.
This is a highly backend-heavy role, roughly
80–90% backend
, ideal for an engineer who loves simplifying complex systems, working close to the customer, and owning meaningful product work end-to-end. The team ships quickly, works directly from customer feedback, and is looking for someone who can thrive in an intense, high-ownership, low-ego environment.
This is best suited for someone who wants to work on hard infrastructure problems, including real-time data sync, legacy system integrations, reliable APIs, testing frameworks, and scalable backend architecture.
Location:
San Francisco, CA

In-person, 5 days/week

Full-time
Experience:
1–5 years
Compensation:
$130,000–$240,000
Visa Sponsorship
: H-1B, O-1, OPT

In this role, you will:
Build and maintain a unified API layer that connects construction ERPs and legacy systems to modern software platforms.
Work with complex legacy systems, including SQL-based, DLL-based, and API-based systems that may be 20–40 years old.
Build core backend infrastructure for products across ERP sync, AP automation, expense management, and vendor management.
Solve real-time data synchronization challenges, including websocket implementations for systems without native webhooks.
Help scale systems handling millions of API requests per day.
Build reliable APIs on top of fragmented legacy systems with strong uptime, SLA, and reliability expectations.
Create scalable testing frameworks to catch edge cases across 1,000+ endpoints.
Own features end-to-end as an individual contributor in a flat engineering team.
Work directly with customers to understand pain points and ship product improvements based on real feedback.
Contribute across backend and full-stack work, including frontend development for internal/customer-facing apps that dog-food the company’s own API.
Qualifications
Strong candidates will have:
1–5 years of backend or full-stack engineering experience.
Strong backend engineering ability, with comfort working on infrastructure, APIs, data sync, and distributed systems.
A
computer science degree from a strong engineering program.
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, ideally
AWS
.
Startup or founding engineering experience, especially at a pre-seed through Series C company.
Experience working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where engineers own problems deeply.
A high-ownership, low-ego working style.
Strong academic background, such as a high GPA, academic honors, debate, or competitive extracurriculars.
Multi-year tenure in a prior role, showing follow-through and depth.
A serious competitive background, such as college or high school athletics, is a strong plus.
Top engineering school background is a plus, especially schools like
UWaterloo
or other top CS programs.
This is especially strong for candidates who have shipped real products, enjoy backend-heavy work, and want to be close to customers and product decisions.
This is probably not the right fit for candidates who are:
Looking for a mostly frontend, mobile, embedded, crypto, LLM, or trendy tech-focused role.
Coming from only big tech without startup experience, unless they have less than 2 years of big-tech-only experience.
Currently prioritizing work-life balance over intensity and ownership.
Primarily interested in construction tech domain experience rather than core backend engineering.
Currently in between roles due to performance-related reasons.
Looking for a new grad role.

90% healthcare cost coverage
with multiple plan options.
100% 401(k) match up to 4%
of annual salary.
Sizable relocation bonus
for candidates outside the Bay Area.
On-site gym with Peloton, squat rack, Tempo, and yoga setup.
Opportunity to join a profitable, fast-growing seed-stage startup backed by top investors.
Direct exposure to customers, product strategy, and core infrastructure decisions.
High-impact engineering ownership on systems used by hundreds of paying customers.

Overview
A fast-growing, seed-stage data infrastructure startup is hiring a
Full-Stack Software Engineer
to help build the core backend systems powering modern software for the construction industry.
This company is building the infrastructure layer that connects fragmented legacy construction systems with modern financial and operational workflows. The product already serves
550+ paying customers on 1–3 year contracts
, is
profitable and cash-flow positive
, and is growing quickly with a small, high-caliber engineering team.
This is a highly backend-heavy role, roughly
80–90% backend
, ideal for an engineer who loves simplifying complex systems, working close to the customer, and owning meaningful product work end-to-end. The team ships quickly, works directly from customer feedback, and is looking for someone who can thrive in an intense, high-ownership, low-ego environment.
This is best suited for someone who wants to work on hard infrastructure problems, including real-time data sync, legacy system integrations, reliable APIs, testing frameworks, and scalable backend architecture.
Location:
San Francisco, CA
Work Type:
In-person, 5 days/week
Employment Type:
Full-time
Experience:
1–5 years
Compensation:
$130,000–$240,000
Visa Sponsorship:
H-1B, O-1, OPT

In this role, you will:
Build and maintain a unified API layer that connects construction ERPs and legacy systems to modern software platforms.
Work with complex legacy systems, including SQL-based, DLL-based, and API-based systems that may be 20–40 years old.
Build core backend infrastructure for products across ERP sync, AP automation, expense management, and vendor management.
Solve real-time data synchronization challenges, including websocket implementations for systems without native webhooks.
Help scale systems handling millions of API requests per day.
Build reliable APIs on top of fragmented legacy systems with strong uptime, SLA, and reliability expectations.
Create scalable testing frameworks to catch edge cases across 1,000+ endpoints.
Own features end-to-end as an individual contributor in a flat engineering team.
Work directly with customers to understand pain points and ship product improvements based on real feedback.
Contribute across backend and full-stack work, including frontend development for internal/customer-facing apps that dog-food the company’s own API.
Qualifications
Strong candidates will have:
1–5 years of backend or full-stack engineering experience.
Strong backend engineering ability, with comfort working on infrastructure, APIs, data sync, and distributed systems.
A
computer science degree from a strong engineering program.
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, ideally
AWS
.
Startup or founding engineering experience, especially at a pre-seed through Series C company.
Experience working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where engineers own problems deeply.
A high-ownership, low-ego working style.
Strong academic background, such as a high GPA, academic honors, debate, or competitive extracurriculars.
Multi-year tenure in a prior role, showing follow-through and depth.
A serious competitive background, such as college or high school athletics, is a strong plus.
Top engineering school background is a plus, especially schools like
UWaterloo
or other top CS programs.
This is especially strong for candidates who have shipped real products, enjoy backend-heavy work, and want to be close to customers and product decisions.

Looking for a mostly frontend, mobile, embedded, crypto, LLM, or trendy tech-focused role.
Coming from only big tech without startup experience, unless they have less than 2 years of big-tech-only experience.
Currently prioritizing work-life balance over intensity and ownership.
Primarily interested in construction tech domain experience rather than core backend engineering.
Currently in between roles due to performance-related reasons.
Looking for a new grad role.

The company offers:
90% healthcare cost coverage
with multiple plan options.
100% 401(k) match up to 4%
of annual salary.
Sizable relocation bonus
for candidates outside the Bay Area.
On-site gym with Peloton, squat rack, Tempo, and yoga setup.
Opportunity to join a profitable, fast-growing seed-stage startup backed by top investors.
Direct exposure to customers, product strategy, and core infrastructure decisions.
High-impact engineering ownership on systems used by hundreds of paying customers.
Visa Sponsorship only available H-1B, O-1, OPT

reason: Stack +28; Title fit +6; Entry +15; US +10
description_preview:
Location
: Santa Ana, California — on-site
Employment
type
: Full-time
Salary
: $120,000 - $155,000
About Us
Created.ai is an AI-powered creative platform combining text, image and video generation into production tools for commercial creative work. The platform is operated by eJam, a multi-brand consumer products and technology company.
We are expanding our engineering team with two appointments covering our AI platform infrastructure and our product engineering surface. Both roles carry substantial technical ownership and report directly into engineering leadership.
This position is AI-native by design. Our engineers work with agentic coding tools as a primary part of their daily workflow, which allows a small team to operate at a scope that would conventionally require a much larger one. We are looking for engineers whose judgement, architectural thinking and review discipline scale that leverage rather than being replaced by it.
Role Summary
We are seeking a Mid-Level Engineer to build and ship features across the created.ai product experience — from the browser client through our NestJS API to the Python AI services that power generation, and back out to how results are presented in the interface.
You will work within an established architecture rather than defining it. A staff engineer sets the platform patterns and a senior engineer reviews your design decisions; your job is to take a well-specified problem, build it properly across the stack, and ship it to production. Over time we expect you to take on progressively larger and less-specified pieces of work.
This suits an engineer with two to four years of production experience who is stronger than their years suggest, wants to work on generative creative tooling, and would rather ship user-facing product than maintain someone else's backlog.
Key Responsibilities
Build and ship end-to-end product features across the request path, working from specifications you help refine
Implement asynchronous user experiences — progress states, partial failures and recovery paths — using the patterns our platform already establishes
Consume and extend typed API contracts between the web client, NestJS services and Python AI services
Build interface components that are consistent with our existing design and component system
Write and maintain automated tests for the code you ship, at unit and integration level
Take part in code review, both giving and receiving it, and act on the feedback
Work with product colleagues to turn creative-tooling ideas into shippable scope
Requirements
Two to four years of professional software engineering experience shipping to production
Strong React and TypeScript — you have built and maintained real components in a real codebase, and you understand the type system rather than fighting it
Comfortable in a modern React toolchain (Next.js, Vite or comparable)
Working knowledge of a Node.js backend framework and a relational database — you can add an endpoint, write a query and reason about the data model
Experience with asynchronous UI: loading and error states, polling or streaming, and what to show a user when something takes thirty seconds or fails halfway
Automated testing as a normal part of your work, in any mainstream framework
Fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or comparable) — specifically, the judgement to review generated code critically rather than shipping it unread, and the honesty to say when you do not understand what it produced
Able to read code confidently in a language you do not primarily write in
Nice to have
None of the following are required. Tell us if you have any of them.
Mantine or another component library at production scale
TanStack Query or comparable client-state tooling
NestJS specifically
SSE or WebSockets, including reconnection and partial-failure handling
Playwright or another end-to-end testing framework
File upload handling, or image and video asset pipelines
Any Python at all — enough to read a FastAPI service and make a small change is genuinely useful here
Canvas, timeline or media-editor work: Pixi, Fabric, Remotion, WebGL or comparable
Exposure to MCP, tool calling or agent-driven interfaces
How You Will Grow Here
You will be the most junior engineer on a small, senior team, which is the fastest way to get better and also occasionally uncomfortable. You will get substantive code review from people with more experience than you, direct exposure to architectural decisions before they are made, and a defined path toward owning full vertical slices of the product. We will tell you plainly where you stand and what would move you to the next level.
Benefits
Health, Dental, Vision
401k Plan
PTO Plan
14 observed local holidays
Stock options
Amazing, pet-friendly office environment
Equipment budget and learning allowance
Real technical ownership within a small engineering team, and visible impact on a commercially active AI product with real users and real scale constraints
Direct involvement in product decisions — the team is small enough that there is nowhere to hide, in both directions

description_preview:
Description
Amazon's Sponsored Products and Brands is building the next generation of AI-powered advertiser controls that help millions of advertisers optimize their campaigns. We're looking for a Software Development Engineer II to join our Advertiser Controls team, where you'll design and build the bidding controls and recommendations that directly impact how advertisers create, optimize, and grow their business on Amazon.
In this role, you'll own the development of three critical platform capabilities. First, you will build the AI engineering infrastructure that enables our bidding systems—developing systems for model fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, model inferencing and preference optimization, while creating evaluation frameworks that ensure safety, reliability, and trust at scale. Second, you will interface agentic architectures that allow AI systems to work together seamlessly, including agent-to-agent communication protocols for discovery, negotiation, and task handoff, lifecycle management for agent sessions, and state management frameworks that persist context across multi-step workflows. Third, you will design and build experimentation systems that support multiple concurrent online experiments, accelerating our team's ability to test new bidding strategies and learn from real advertiser behavior.
As an SDE2, you'll work as an autonomous contributor. You will work backwards from advertiser needs—collaborating with product managers, scientists, and other engineers to understand business problems, then translating those into technical solutions. While you'll make independent decisions on implementation, you'll seek guidance from senior engineers and principals when facing complex architectural tradeoffs or ambiguous technical challenges where the business problem is clear but the path forward requires exploration.
The work you do will have direct, visible impact. This infrastructure will power the AI systems that help a small business owner optimize their first campaign and enable enterprise brands to manage millions in ad spend. You'll be building customer-facing products where your technical decisions translate directly into advertiser success and the products customers discover on Amazon.
Key job responsibilities
Design and develop the Agentic platform using Gen AI/ML technologies to deliver low-latency, secure advertiser experiences
Build scalable systems that process millions of data points and optimize for cost efficiency through resource utilization, token consumption, and memory management
Develop conversational AI and natural language interactions for advertiser bidding guidance
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI-driven solutions across the advertising ecosystem
Identify and eliminate root causes of operational issues with permanent fixes; proactively improve team operations, tooling, and processes
Write high-quality, maintainable code with clear documentation
Provide meaningful code reviews, mentor engineers, and train new teammates on system architecture and operations
What We're Looking For
Passionate about Generative AI, Large Language Models, and their real-world applications
Strong software engineering skills with experience in distributed systems and cloud technologies
Creative problem-solver who thrives in ambiguity and loves tackling complex challenges
Track record of delivering innovative solutions that drive business impact
Enthusiasm for staying current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape
About The Team
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
Experience programming with at least one software programming language
Strong technical fluency in Generative AI, including a deep understanding of large language models (LLMs), model fine tuning, prompt engineering, Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI model trade-offs (e.g., model size, latency, cost, and output quality).
Preferred Qualifications
3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
Master's degree or equivalent
Experience in an online advertising role and have familiarity with advertising products and ad serving technologies
Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale

WHO WE ARE:
Droneforge builds low-cost autonomous aerial systems designed to accomplish real work in real environments. We combine our own hardware, autonomy software, and programmable FPV drones to make capable robotic deployments dramatically more accessible and scalable. We’re hiring an early-career Flight Controls / Guidance, Navigation, and Control Engineer to help move these systems from controlled indoor environments into reliable outdoor operation. You’ll analyze real flight data, identify system dynamics, improve state estimation, tune controllers, design experiments, and validate your work on physical aircraft.
ROLE DESCRIPTION:
This is a full-time, on-site Entry-Level Flight Controls / GNC Engineer role based in El Segundo, CA. You will design, implement, and test the control and state-estimation systems that enable our low-cost autonomous UAVs to operate reliably in real-world environments. Your work will include modeling vehicle and sensor dynamics, identifying systems from flight data, tuning control laws, integrating flight-control software with the Droneforge autonomy OS, and validating performance through simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and physical flight tests. You will diagnose instability, sensor noise, latency, and tracking failures, then turn those findings into production improvements. You will own the majority of this pipeline and iterate quickly; your code and control systems will directly affect more than 200 active deployments.
Qualifications
Strong foundation in classical and modern flight-control theory, including plant modeling, system identification, Laplace transforms, transfer functions, state-space representations, stability analysis, frequency-domain methods, and feedback-controller design.
Familiarity with state estimation and sensor fusion—including Kalman filters—and the ability to apply these concepts to aerial systems with noisy sensors, communication delays, and imperfect models.
Knowledge of aerospace engineering and aerodynamics principles relevant to unmanned-aircraft performance and stability.
Understanding of aircraft-design concepts, including configuration tradeoffs, stability, and actuator or control-surface integration.
Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Machine learning and natural language processing
Tools

About The Job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
Our team owns and maintains Low Level Virtual Machines (LLVM) based compiler infrastructure at Google which underpins several major toolchains at Google including the Clang compiler for C/C++ and the Multi-Level Intermediate Representation (MLIR) framework that is heavily used for AI/ML compilation use cases. Our charter includes feature development, tight integration of upstream OSS code into google3 toolchains, metrics development and analysis, AI driven analysis of code commits, research work in memory safe languages, and active engagement with the upstream open source LLVM community.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Support integrating new versions of compilers into the toolchain, which often requires debugging and fixing failures in Google code introduced by new compiler code.
Maintain active engagement with the open source community.

Device connectivity and data pipelines are reliable enough to run in cadaver labs and clinical studies without drama.

At Kao, we offer amazing benefits that are available to you on your first day of employment (healthcare, 401(k) plus company match), 36 total days off (vacation + holidays + sick) and a reasonable salary range of $95,000 - $110,000. We also offer a hybrid work schedule (Needs to be in Cincinnati area or willing to relocate to the area).
What you will do:
Design, develop, document and manage scalable integration solutions for B2B/EDI transactions (e.g., X12 850, 810, and 856 and EDIFACT) and partner onboardings. This can include end-to-end SDLC functions from analysis to development to testing to deployment to hyper care. This can further include project management related aspects such as scope, schedule, and status for these integration solutions. With familiarity, supervise and lead teams to produce such integration solutions.
Develop and maintain application and data integration platform workflows using Informatica Integration Cloud Solutions (IICS) and Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) with initial focus on B2B/EDI flows, but will also include Cloud Application Integration (CAI), Cloud Data Integration (CDI), and Cloud Data Integration and Replication (CDIR). Support data quality, transformation, and mapping efforts across systems. This would also include scope, schedule, and status for these integration solutions.
Collaborate with business units (e.g., supply chain, sales, finance) and internal and external teams to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions. This would include using related tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Zephyr.
Monitor and troubleshoot integration jobs and data flows to ensure reliability and performance. Document integration processes, data flows, and technical specifications.
Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to the evolution of our integration and data platforms.
What you will need:
Bachelor's degree or Equivalent Business Experience (Computer/Data Science or Business Related).
5+ years of B2B/EDI experience developing workflows and data mapping - especially within Cloud+SaaS.
Familiarity with EDI standards (X12, EDIFACT, TRADACOMS) consumer products or supply chain context.
Experience with EDI transactions for Retail/Supply Chain (Transactions such as X12 850, 855, 856, 810, 824, 864 and EDIFACT Equivalents).
Familiarity with data transport for integration – using standards such as AS2, X.400, and EDI VAN.
Experience with testing EDI solutions with EDI partners or 3rd Parties such as SPS, EDIComm.
Understand standard business processes associated with EDI flows, such as: Order->Confirmation->Fulfillment->Invoice->Payment.
Experience with SAP and IDOCs in conjunction with Integration Solutions.
Informatica integration and data platforms: IICS and/or IDMC, with modules such as: Business to Business (B2B), Cloud Application Integration (CAI), Cloud Data Integration (CDI), and Cloud Data Integration and Replication (CDIR).
Experience with EDI for 3PL, Logistics and Transportation (Transactions such as X12 940, 943, 944, 945, 211, 214 and EDIFACT Equivalents).
Experience in designing/performing large scale testing for both new processes and regression testing.
What we offer:
A friendly and flexible work environment with great compensation packages, benefits package, ongoing development and the opportunity to enhance your skills and deliver tangible results. At Kao your voice will be heard. Your opinion really counts. We believe that change comes from taking opportunities into your own hands, so we value and reward thinking and new ideas.
Hiring Process:
Kao embraces the diversity and the individual personalities of its people because we believe it is diversity that makes us strong. This is why we welcome applications from all areas of the global community.
Want to learn more:
If you feel you are as unique as our products and want to find out why 33,000 people across the globe opted for a career with us please visit our Americas website (
https://www.kao.com/americas/en/
).
Kao USA is an equal opportunity employer, including disability/vets.

State Street’s Wealth Custody & Clearing business is seeking multiple Assistant Vice Presidents, Software Engineers to join our growing Technology organization. We are seeking engineers with experience in senior backend development, software development engineering, API-driven platforms, distributed systems, cloud-enabled development, and enterprise application delivery. The team you will be joining is part of Wealth Custody & Clearing, a strategic growth initiative focused on building a modern, scalable, and highly integrated platform for RIAs, broker-dealers, and wealth management firms. Software Engineers are critical to delivering the digital capabilities, services, integrations, and operational workflows required to support a highly regulated, transaction-oriented wealth platform.

Experience with cloud-enabled development, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automated testing, and modern software delivery tooling
Experience with relational databases, NoSQL databases, messaging platforms, observability tools, monitoring, logging, and performance optimization preferred
